**Coaching note:**
When you have a knight that can give check near the opponent's king, calculate forcing moves carefully. Here, Ng3+ looks like it sacrifices the knight, but after the forced hxg3, the h-file opens and your rook delivers checkmate on h5. White's king has no escape because h2 is gone and g1 has the rook. Always look for follow-up tactics after your opponent is forced to recapture.
